info.title: cozy machine API
info.description: One machine's API on its pinned-TLS port (design/machine-http-api.md). Every request carries `authorization: Cozy-Cap <token>`; refusals are the error envelope; unknown fields are ignored.

get.summary:
Answers 204 when nothing authorizes the request, 401 when something does: a probe that the
listener is up.

post.summary: Starts a rental's idle clock over and answers the frame with the new deadline.

409.description: This machine has no idle deadline

get.summary:
A log the machine keeps (`tensorfs-transport`, `memory`, `tensord`): its whole lines. With
`Accept: text/event-stream`, those and then each batch as it is appended, across rotations.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Its newest N whole lines; absent or 0: all

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Follow on from this event's place

200.description: The lines, or SSE `event: lines` with the place after them as id

post.summary:
What the machine holds of many objects in one request, in the order asked: each stored object
whole (renewed, as a `HEAD` renews it), else the ranges its upload has landed.

get.summary:
What this signer's upload of the object holds as its parts land, as SSE `held` events after
each MiB more, ending once it holds all `length` bytes. A stored object answers at once.

put.summary:
Lands one part of the object: the body is `Content-Range`'s bytes (without it, the whole
object). Parts may go side by side, in any order. Once the held ranges cover the object, the
machine verifies its sha256 and stores it for the signer; bytes that differ are dropped
(`object_digest_mismatch`).

head.summary:
The byte ranges of the object the machine holds for this signer, in `Cozy-Held`. A stored
object is held whole, and asking renews it, so a run sent next finds it.

post.summary:
Submits a run, idempotent on its id per signer: the same id with the same spec answers its
state; with another spec, `run_id_conflict`. An update's activation and a rental's idle
release wait for it.

409.description: `run_id_conflict`, or a refusal of the run

post.summary:
Cancels the run. An id the machine never received is recorded canceled, so a late submit of
it answers that.

get.summary:
The run's log after `Last-Event-ID` as SSE: first `state` (the snapshot), then `progress`,
`product`, `log`, `call`, `gpu` and finally `outcome`, after which the stream ends. Durable
events carry `id: <sequence>`; live ones none. Closing it never cancels the run.
An output's current bytes, readable while it grows (each revision is a `product` event).

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: A list item's 1-based index; absent for a single output

parameters.name: member
parameters.description: One file of a tree output, by its manifest path

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: `"<rev>"`: refuse once the output moved past it

get.summary: A failed attempt's retained triage bundle.

The machine's picture. Without a machine-scope cap: identity, version, capabilities and the
sealed readiness receipt only (what a Hub reads). With one: all of it, and with `Accept:
text/event-stream` an SSE stream of `status` events, each the whole frame, sent again when it
changes.

200.description: The frame, or SSE `event: status` frames

401.description: A credential this machine does not admit

manifest.description: `sha256:<hex>`, the owner's checkpoint by hash; else `model` at `release`, `lane`.

source.description:
A provider source (`civitai://<version>`, `hf://…`) made here and normalized at ingest,
under these reviewed `profiles` (none: the one its headers select); never with `model`.

Adjustment.description: One request field served other than as sent.

Call.description: One settled call the run made: a child run, or an effect such as its weights publication.

computation_digest.description: A memoized call's computation (`sha256:<hex>`), ran or answered.

index.description: Its index among the run's calls.

memoized.description: Answered from a result this machine held; nothing ran.

unmemoized.description: Why a memoizable call was neither looked up nor held ("seed not given").

Envelope.description: The HTTP body of a refusal.

hub.description: The Hub origin a published installation came from; empty for local code.

level.description: What it holds now (as [`WarmItem::holds`]), in a warm set or not.

warning.description: Why it does not run the machine's own Runtime; empty when it does.

cause.description: The originating component's own stable code (a machine's or the Hub's), when not ours.

next.description: Commands to try next; at most two.

family.description: The tensor-core row by compute capability ("sm90"); empty: unread.

memory_class.description: discrete, coherent (GH200, GB200), unified (GB10); empty: unread.

memory_limit_bytes.description: The most of `memory_bytes` this machine uses (`machine.gpu_memory_limit`); 0: all of it.

GpuAllocation.description:
A root run's GPU allocation changed: `grant` binds its lane, `wait` queues it behind `behind`
(a run id), `release` ends its lane (`Context.release_gpus()` or its exit).

gpus.description: The lane, as machine GPU indices.

HeldAnswer.description:
What the machine holds of each object asked, in the order asked; a stored object is held
whole, and asking renews it, as a `HEAD` does.

HeldBytes.description: What an upload holds, as `GET /v1/objects/sha256:<hex>?length=N` streams it (`event: held`).

held.description: Bytes landed, synced or not; the last event says all N.

ranges.description: Byte ranges `[start, end)`; none: nothing held.

HeldRequest.description:
`POST /v1/objects/held`: which of these objects (`sha256:<hex>`) the machine holds for this
signer.

HubAccess.description: A Hub a run reads. Public content is read anonymously.

ca_der.description: An origin's private CA (DER, base64), when it has one.

capability.description:
The owner's capability for this run's private operations (th-241): a compact JWS its
device key signed for this machine's leaf (`cnf.jkt`) and the Hub's resource (`aud`),
naming each operation in `authorization_details`. The machine trades it once, at the run's
first private operation, at `token_endpoint`. Empty: a public-only run.

object_hosts.description: The Hub's object-storage hosts downloads may follow.

token_endpoint.description: The Hub's authorization server's, as its metadata names it.

field.description: The payload field path, list index included.

KernelVerdict.description:
One kernel's verification on this machine (the Runtime's `verify_op`), keyed by its
artifact, the card's architecture and the driver.

detail.description: What was measured, or why it failed.

LocalSource.description:
Local code: `manifest` names a JSON object written with `PUT /v1/objects`:
`{package: "local/<dist>", release, python_requires, python_version, callees: {distribution:
package}}` and its code. A live project is installed editable from `files: [{name, digest,
length, executable}]`: the project and the path dependencies its lock names, each file under
their common directory, with `project` the project's directory there. The machine keeps one
such tree and one environment per signer and package. `path` names that common directory on
this computer's machine, which reads it in place. `wheels: [{name, digest, length}]` are locked
dependencies the caller carries because the machine cannot fetch them. Members are objects the
same signer wrote.

LogLines.description: Whole lines of a machine log, as `GET /v1/logs/{name}` streams them (`event: lines`).

after.description: The place after them, also the event's id: a follow resumed there goes on with the next line.

repository.description: org/name; org "local" is a local alias.

unique_bytes.description: Reached by no other held repository.

ModelChoice.description:
One model slot's choice, by name (th-245: the machine resolves it at the Hub). A Hub model is
`repository` at `release` (empty: the newest) in `lane`, else in the lane the machine's rules
pick (xs-042). `manifest` names a checkpoint by hash only: the owner's private one at the Hub
(with `repository`; the run's capability names it) or one this machine holds (without). A slot
with no choice takes its declared default release, a callee's included (`<package>/<path>`).

adapters.description: Each by name, a hash of the owner's, or a provider source.

parameter.description: A root slot parameter or full slot path.

source.description:
A provider source (`hf://<org>/<repo>@<rev>[/member]`, `civitai://<version>[/file]`) the
machine makes the slot's model from, under these reviewed `profiles` (none: the one its
headers select); never with repository or manifest.

adjustments.description: How its executor served the request other than as sent, in the executor's order. Advisory.

computation_digest.description: A memoizable callable's computation (`sha256:<hex>`), whether it ran or was answered.

execution_ms.description: Its own time running its callable, every attempt summed; 0: unknown.

oneOf.description:
What its executor measured, canonical JSON: `attribution` (stage and step tracks),
`execution` (degree, ranks with the GPU and attention each served, executor boot,
construction load and warm) and `observations` (attention rows). None for a run that ran
on no device.

memoized.description: Answered from a result this machine held: nothing ran.

oneOf.description: The result, canonical JSON, assets as digests.

unmemoized.description: Why it was neither looked up nor held (its author's condition unmet, e.g. "seed not given").

Product.description:
One revision of an output: a single output is replaced by each, a list output grows. Its bytes
are `GET /v1/runs/{id}/outputs/{output}`.

appended_from.description: These bytes extend the previous revision's, from here.

duration_us.description: Media time, for a growing video.

index.description: A list item's 1-based index; 0 for a single output.

stage_fraction.description: How far this stage is, when it says.

step_ms.description: The latest step's time, while a stage steps.

ProviderAccess.description: The caller's provider tokens, for models a run makes from a provider source.

detail.description:
A failed call's traceback, else its executor's stderr: the last lines, secrets masked.
It explains the failure after its machine is gone.

Release.description:
A published release by name (th-245): a machine that holds no installation of it reads its
card and locked requirements at the Hub by name.

RunEvent.description:
One entry of a run's log, as `GET /v1/runs/{id}/events` sends it: SSE `event: <variant>`,
`id: <sequence>` for durable entries.

sequence.description: 0: a frame that is not in the log (the snapshot, progress before acceptance, live state).

RunRequest.description:
`POST /v1/runs`: submits when `id` is new (idempotent on id per signer); the same id with
another spec is `run_id_conflict`.

bits.description:
The run's weight precision: 16, 8 or 4. 0: the machine's rules choose each slot's lane.
Children inherit it.

catalog_revision.description:
The catalog revision the caller made its choices under (th-245): a held resolution is
reused only under the same one, so a publish, yank, bind or retarget the caller knows of
resolves once more at the Hub.

gpus.description:
0: widest group every model slot supports on this machine. Positive: at most this many
GPUs, for the run and its children.

oneOf.description: Where the run reads, and its capability there.

inputs.description: Objects uploaded with `PUT /v1/objects`, bound to payload fields.

owner.description: The account that org-relative references of local code name.

oneOf.description: The function's parameters, a JSON object.
Provider tokens for source models, memory only like `hub`.

`warm/2`: the caller's whole warm set, replacing its previous one; no items clears it.
The run installs and downloads every member, and its result lists each one's `level` and
`held_back`. Absent: the set is left as it is.

weights_destination.description:
org/name: the requester's repository for the call's weights outputs, or a warm run's
source model.

state.description: queued, preparing, running, succeeded, failed, canceled

waiting.description: Why a queued run waits, for people.

oneOf.description: An installation this machine already holds for the signer.

installation.description: An installation this machine already holds for the signer.

StatusFrame.description:
The machine's picture. Without a machine-scope cap, `GET /v1/status` answers identity,
version, capabilities and the sealed readiness `receipt` only. With one it answers all of it,
and as SSE (`Accept: text/event-stream`) sends the whole frame again whenever it changes. An
open stream is not activity.

commit.description: The commit its `cozy` binary was built from.

dev.description: Its binary arrived by a dev update (`cozy machine update --tensord`), not a release.

oneOf.description: The filesystem holding the machine's store.

driver_floor.description: The oldest NVIDIA driver this machine's kernels run on; empty: no GPU stack.

idle_deadline_unix_ms.description:
An idle rental's release, 15 min after its last job; 0: none (a job is queued or running,
or it never releases).

kernels.description: Each native kernel's verdict on this machine's cards, as the Runtime keeps it.

models.description: The models the machine's store holds.

models_bytes.description: Their bytes together, shared content counted once.

receipt.description: The sealed readiness envelope (base64); empty until sealed.

toolchain.description: What builds kernels here when no prebuilt one serves the card.

warm.description: The caller's warm set, each with what it holds now.

oneOf.description: The direct player endpoint, when the machine listens.

Toolchain.description: The machine's build toolchain: CUDA's compiler and a host C/C++ compiler.

host_compiler.description: The host compiler's first version line; empty: none found.

install.description: The OS's own command for a missing host compiler; empty when none is missing or known.

WarmItem.description:
One member of a caller's warm set: a function the machine keeps ready up to `level`. It is
the last idle thing to give its memory to a request, and comes back when room returns.

held_back.description: Status only: why that is lower than `level`.

holds.description: Status only: the level it holds now (installed, downloaded, imported, host, gpu).

models.description: None: the slots' defaults, as for a run.

WarmLevel.description: How far a function is kept ready; each level includes the ones before it.

WarmSource.description: What a warm set's member keeps ready.

addresses.description: host:port to dial: own interfaces, or the provider's mapping.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex of the certificate its DTLS presents.

port.description: The listener; a persistent machine keeps it across restarts.

unavailable_reason.description: Why no address is reported (a malformed mapping).

cozy_cap.name: authorization
cozy_cap.description: `Cozy-Cap <token>`: machine scope does everything as its signer; run scope reads one run's events and its granted outputs.
